game_concept: A puzzle set in Coastal Port – Storm Breakwater, a breakwater in a storm: the shipwright must handle storm gulls while practicing conditionals (if / elif / else). Core idea – And/Or Locks: Combine conditions with and/or to open a lock that needs several clues.
theme: Coastal Port – Storm Breakwater: a breakwater in a storm
core_gameplay_loop: In Storm Breakwater, repeat each round: Combine conditions with and/or to open a lock that needs several clues. Each round costs one action, so plan the step so none are wasted. Then check the lock_progress value and advance.
player_objective: Reach the lighthouse lamp using at most 17 actions, so every code step counts.
controls: Keyboard: arrow keys move the hero, SPACE performs the main action, ENTER runs the code.
win_condition: The lighthouse lamp reached with actions_used <= 17.
lose_condition: actions_used exceeds 17 before the lighthouse lamp is reached, or lives reach 0.
learning_alignment: Week 3 – Conditionals (if / elif / else) | Level 7 (applied tier): And/Or Locks
assets_style: pixel-art harbor town: deep blue sea, wooden docks, orange-roofed buildings, sailing ships; flat Kenney-style sprites; sea-shanty accordion with wave and gull ambience
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'And/Or Locks' (Week 3 slot 4), mission type 'Efficiency Trial', and setting 'Storm Breakwater'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: Coastal Port
region.mood: sea-shanty accordion with wave and gull ambience

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how lock_progress changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against storm gulls in Storm Breakwater.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: The lighthouse lamp reached with actions_used <= 17.
